instruction: Apply statutory emergency removal standard to fact pattern involving clutter vs imminent danger.

input.facts: Caseworker observed unwashed dishes and cluttered floor; children were uninjured, nourished, and happy. Caseworker removed children.

instruction: Apply urgent necessity standard to temporary housing loss without physical hazard.

input.facts: Family faced eviction notice; mother had identified temporary shelter with maternal aunt; agency petitioned for out-of-home foster care.

instruction: Apply Ohio reasonable grounds standard where able relative is present at apprehension.

input.facts: Single mother taken to hospital for migraine; grandmother was in home caring for children; police transported children to county shelter.

instruction: Apply California substantial risk standard where alleged incident was isolated and resolved.

input.facts: Parents had verbal dispute two months prior while child was absent; no physical domestic violence occurred; agency filed Section 300 petition.

instruction: Apply Florida emergency removal criteria to unverified telephone referral.

input.facts: Anonymous caller claimed mother was shouting; investigator visited, found child sleeping peacefully with ample food and utilities functioning.

instruction: Apply Texas immediate danger standard where utility cutoff can be remedied with community funds.

input.facts: Electric bill was overdue for 3 days during mild weather; church offered payment guarantee; caseworker removed child without court order.

instruction: Apply Pennsylvania clear necessity test where parent has valid medical prescription.

input.facts: Mother tested positive for prescribed ADHD medication; caseworker alleged illicit substance abuse without verifying physician records.

instruction: Apply Georgia protective custody statute where responsible adult relative is available.

input.facts: Father was arrested on unpaid traffic citations; adult aunt residing in same apartment complex was present to care for child.

source: Official Code of Georgia Annotated O.C.G.A. § 15-11-133

instruction: Apply North Carolina temporary custody statute to school attendance referral.

input.facts: Child had 10 unexcused absences due to lack of school bus route; caseworker removed child alleging educational neglect.

instruction: Apply Michigan emergency removal standard where family has arranged safe alternative heating.

input.facts: Home furnace failed; parent immediately relocated children to grandmother's warm residence while repair technician was scheduled.
